items.title_zh: ADS1299 核心 SDK：开放 EEG/BCI 生态
items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK for Open EEG/BCI Ecosystem
bullets_zh: 面向8–64通道非侵入式脑机接口的开源ADS1299 EEG/BCI生态。
提供硬件/固件资源，包括MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA目标、Verilog RTL及PC/移动/Linux集成。
包含Python/MATLAB/R分析、验证、教育与研究工作流，用于EEG脑机接口开发。
bullets_en: Open-source ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem targeting 8–64-channel non-invasive brain-computer interfaces.
Provides hardware/firmware resources including MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA targets, Verilog RTL, and PC/mobile/Linux integration.
Includes Python/MATLAB/R analysis, validation, education, and research workflows for EEG-based BCI development.
items.brief: 开源ADS1299 EEG/BCI硬件与软件生态，便于搭建非侵入式脑电系统。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI hardware and software ecosystem for building non-invasive brain-computer interfaces.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

items.title_zh: 使用EEG微状态研究神经发育中瞬时大规模功能脑网络动态的教程
items.title_en: Tutorial on using EEG microstates to study moment-to-moment large-scale functional brain network dynamics in neurodevelopment
bullets_zh: Frontiers文章提供EEG微状态在神经发育研究中的教程。
它解释微状态如何捕捉大规模功能网络构型与转换的快速动态。
该资源有助于非侵入式EEG脑网络分析及相关BCI研究。
bullets_en: Frontiers article presents a tutorial on EEG microstates for neurodevelopment research.
It explains how microstates capture fast large-scale functional network configurations and transitions.
The resource is useful for non-invasive EEG-based brain-network analysis in BCI-adjacent studies.
items.brief: EEG微状态教程，用于研究神经发育中的全脑功能网络动态。
items.brief_en: EEG microstate tutorial for studying whole-brain functional network dynamics in neurodevelopment.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG microstates are topographical patterns of EEG activity that offer a lens into the fast temporal dynamics of large-scale functional network activity and whole-brain functional organization. Microstates can capture temporal patterns of network configurations and transitions between these configurations at the millisecond scale.
